title: The "Problem” of Human Label Variation: On Ground Truth in Data, Modeling and Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper is a position piece that does not conduct a specific empirical bias measurement; instead, it synthesizes literature on human label variation (HLV). It advocates evaluating annotator subjectivity and disagreement by replacing single "ground truth" majority-vote labels with un-aggregated human label distributions and using soft evaluation metrics (e.g., cross-entropy, entropy correlation, and annotator-level data splits).
